description: A risk committee chair must approve and structure a proposed purchase of distressed municipal bonds, setting the purchase face value, execution schedule, accounting classification, concentration control, settlement documentation, and single-cycle execution status with input from credit risk, legal, markets, and accounting.

shared_context.S1: The bank has been offered a block of distressed municipal bonds with a face value of $12000000.
shared_context.S2: The bonds are currently quoted at 82 cents on the dollar and mature in 30 months.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the binding decision on whether the bank will purchase the bonds and on the conditions attached to the purchase.
shared_context.S4: Under the committee's normal pre-trade procedure, credit risk, legal, markets, and accounting each state any conditions or implementation requirements before Elena records the vote; each function-holder must use a formal reveal action to disclose the specific finding, because merely saying that a finding exists does not satisfy the pre-trade disclosure requirement. Elena records the vote immediately after the last of those four functions has stated its conditions. The committee's vote template uses the decision field 'issuer_exposure_limit_controlled', not 'issuer_exposure_controlled', and this field must be set to true when the issuer exposure limit is confirmed. Legal settlement conditions use the commitment type 'legal_condition'.

PF1.text: Victor confirmed in the exposure report he reviewed this morning that the bank already has $4000000 of exposure to this issuer, and the applicable single-issuer limit is $10000000; the position has not yet been added to the committee packet.

PF2.text: Nadia received a transfer-agent memo this afternoon stating that this bond block may settle only after the buyer provides a beneficial-owner certification and uses an approved municipal-bond custodian; she has not yet attached the memo to the trade file.

PF3.text: Hassan confirmed with the execution desk today that the desk's $5000000 cap is a per-cycle maximum, and the committee must size the total purchase at exactly $5000000 face value executed over exactly four trading days in a single cycle; multi-cycle phasing to exceed $5000000 total is not permitted, and purchase_face_value_usd refers to face value, not purchase cost. The desk's liquidity note is still in his working blotter.

PF4.text: Grace determined while reviewing the bond terms this week that the contractual cash flows include a contingent step-up feature, so the position must be recorded at fair value through profit or loss rather than held at amortized cost; her accounting memo is awaiting circulation.

acceptance_conditions: The purchase face value must be exactly $5000000 and must remain within the issuer exposure limit.
Execution must occur over exactly four trading days in one cycle.
The bonds must be classified as fair value through profit or loss, also known as FVTPL.
The settlement plan must include a beneficial-owner certification and an approved municipal-bond custodian.
The issuer exposure limit must be recorded as a control.
The execution decision must explicitly record that the purchase occurs in one cycle.

content_checks.C4: decisions['accounting_classification'] in ['fair_value_through_profit_or_loss', 'fair value through profit or loss', 'fair value through profit and loss', 'FVTPL', 'fair-value through profit or loss', 'fair-value through profit and loss']
content_checks.C6: decisions['settlement_requires_special_documentation'] == True and any(c['type'] == 'legal_condition' and ('beneficial-owner certification' in c['detail'] or 'beneficial owner certification' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'legal_condition' and ('approved municipal-bond custodian' in c['detail'] or 'approved municipal bond custodian' in c['detail'] or 'municipal-bond custodian' in c['detail'] or 'municipal bond custodian' in c['detail'] or 'approved custodian' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: decisions['execution_single_cycle'] == True and decisions['purchase_face_value_usd'] == 5000000 and decisions['execution_days'] == 4

decisive_facts.why: The existing $4000000 issuer exposure and $10000000 limit change issuer_exposure_limit_controlled from false or unspecified to true and require the $5000000 purchase to remain within a $6000000 incremental capacity.

The transfer-agent memo changes settlement_requires_special_documentation from false or unspecified to true and adds both a beneficial-owner certification and an approved municipal-bond custodian to the settlement commitment.
The desk's explicit single-cycle instruction changes purchase_face_value_usd to exactly $5000000 face value, execution_days to exactly 4, and execution_single_cycle to true.

The contingent step-up feature changes accounting_classification from an ordinary amortized-cost treatment to fair value through profit or loss, including the equivalent fair value through profit and loss and FVTPL labels.
